expo.name: ChargeBridge
expo.description: Find, review, and charge at independent EV charging stations near you. Browse community-reported stations, get real-time availability, compare prices, and pay securely in-app.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ChargeBridge needs your location to find nearby EV charging and gas stations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ChargeBridge needs your location for turn-by-turn navigation and to find nearby EV charging and gas stations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: ChargeBridge uses your location in the background for turn-by-turn navigation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ChargeBridge uses your photo library so you can set a custom wallpaper on any tab.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: ChargeBridge reads your calendar to let you navigate to upcoming appointments and meetings that have addresses.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ChargeBridge Voice uses your microphone to hear hands-free commands — microphone is only active while the app is open and you are speaking.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: ChargeBridge Voice converts your speech to control the app hands-free. All recognition happens on-device and no audio is stored.

plugins.microphonePermission: ChargeBridge Voice uses your microphone to hear hands-free commands — only active while the app is open.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: ChargeBridge Voice converts your speech to control the app hands-free. No audio is stored.
